label: broken

unstated.what: set_crs must assign the new CRS onto spatial_partitions (not merely copy the partitions, which copy() does and which leaves their CRS as None)
GeoSeries.set_crs must preserve spatial partitions and set their CRS too; the instruction names only GeoDataFrame.set_crs

instruction_covers: GeoDataFrame.set_crs must keep an existing spatial_partitions geometry instead of dropping it to None
when spatial_partitions is None it stays None, and set_crs still sets the frame CRS
notes: set_crs lives on _Frame and currently returns map_partitions without propagating partitions. copy() only does spatial_partitions.copy(), which does not set a CRS. calculate_spatial_partitions builds a GeoSeries whose CRS is None. The minimal fix matching the instruction and the cited copy() behavior keeps geometries and fails both CRS assertions. Inheriting the method onto GeoSeries is R2-guessable, but the CRS assignment is new semantics.
